title.narrative: Ukraine's resilience and recovery against HIV/TB due to the war - Ukraine (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Ukraine, TB/HIV, State Institution "Public Health Center of the Ministry of Health of Ukraine" (PHC Ukraine)This program has the following goals: Reduce the human suffering and socioeconomic burden associated with HIV/AIDS and TB in Ukraine in war conditions, promote people-centred, gender-sensitive and rights-based enabling environments and systems, in order to give an effective and sustainable response to HIV and TB, by (i) leveraging gains and closing the gap in the progress towards the 95-95-95 targets: increase early HIV detection, ensure scale up of ART and improve HIV care quality, by maintaining essential and innovative prevention interventions and (ii) maintaining the access to an effective up-to-date TB diagnosis, treatment and prevention, with special attention to Key and Vulnerable Populations.. The objectives of this program are: Prevent HIV transmission, by securing coverage with prevention interventions in key populations, removing the dichotomy between HIV prevention and HIV care service continuums, and eliminating MTCT. Ensure early HIV detection, scale up ART and improve HIV care quality, by scaling-up innovative testing approaches, ensuring access to quality ART, implementing differentiated people-centered models of HIV treatment and care. Sustain effective TB responses by ensuring universal access to people-centered high quality TB and DR-TB prevention, diagnosis, treatment and support. Remove human rights and gender barriers and achieve zero discrimination towards people with HIV and TB and representatives of key and vulnerable groups. Empower people living with, at risk of and affected by HIV and ensure community-led TB and HIV responses. Support health system reforms for resilience and quality care delivery for disease control at the time of crisis

Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
TCS- Other 1: Number of PLWH reached with community-based care and support
Percentage of adults (15 and above) on ART among all adults living with HIV at the end of the reporting period

Percentage of children (under 15) on ART among all children living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of people who inject drugs reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Number of transgender people who received any PrEP product at least once during the reporting period

Number of sex workers who received any PrEP product at least once during the reporting period

Number of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of people who inject drugs receiving opioid substitution therapy
TBDT- Other 1: Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (female) (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of MSM who received any PrEP product at least once during the reporting period
Percentage of sex workers that have received an HIV test during the reporting period in KP-specific programs and know their results
Percentage of MSM that have received an HIV test during the reporting period in KP-specific programs and know their results
Percentage of people living with HIV currently enrolled on antiretroviral therapy who started TB preventive treatment (TPT) during the reporting period
KP-Other 1: Number of eligible people who received any PrEP product at leest once during the reporting period (other than KPs)
Percentage of sex workers reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services

Percentage of people newly diagnosed with HIV initiated on ART
